ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 8:1 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white/light-gray pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. The left tip shows dense white mottling; the right tip shows white coverage with embedded dark spots. Central and medial regions are predominantly low-intensity black with sparse high-intensity linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 40 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations. Large, distinct blunt peaks are visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe. Finer, sharper serrations are present along the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curve immediately adjacent to the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex sweep toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white spots concentrated on the distal margins of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized calcified formations or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks). A set of parallel diagonal lines is visible on the right lobe; several curved and crossing lines are visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the ventral surface; heavy scarring or barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged protrusion on the extreme left distal edge, diverging from the primary lobe curve.
